launches.title: Ekho Labs - Forecasting Supply Chain Disruptions
launches.body:
**TLDR:**

**Companies with global supply chains lose money to every small disruption. Ekho makes sure they don't.**

**Problem:**

Manufacturing means choosing suppliers, booking transport, and keeping pulse on new tariffs - to make sure your production is fine. Companies tend to find out about disruptions when things break and cost them millions.

**Solution:**

Ekho customers get an early warning AND optimal solution 1-3 weeks ahead of the events. So ships keep moving, production lines keep running, and customer promises get kept.

I used to build signal detection systems for DARPA. Now that same type of engine watches 1M+ sources for the industry our phones, food, and clothes depend on - Supply Chains. What you get:

* **Freight forwarders:** container-level forecasts. We’ll tell you what happens, when, and what to do while freight is still available and cheap. Your clients hear about the disruption from you, not from the news.
* **Manufacturers and retailers:** you know which inbound materials will miss the production run, launch, or retailer order - and the cheapest fix, from expediting to switching suppliers or lanes.

**Proof we’re cool:**

1. When the Strait of Hormuz closed in February, we correctly predicted ceasefire dates, duration, and next steps in the war (<https://ekholabs.com/blog/the-hormuz-brief/>)
2. We already work with large global companies

**Ask**

Intro us to Supply Chains VPs/COO at a retail (Target, Walmart, etc.), manufacturing (Fashion, Electronics, Food, etc.), or Freight Forwarding companies.
